g.data-font-note: Original CORE title is outlined path data from the CDR conversion; the source font is not embedded. This title is newly typeset from locally installed Oswald variable font instantiated at weight 700, converted to glyph paths with fontTools, then drawn as the SAME path twice (black stroke with round joins, then white fill). It is stacked as CARDPUTER / ZERO so the long product name stays inside the original CORE title slot [42.207, 190.863, 110.863, 215.346] without covering the yellow slogan capsule or the character. Visible outline thickness is half the stroke (stroke is centered; fill covers the inner half). This is NOT a 100% match to the original CORE outlined glyphs: Oswald is a substitute face, the original four-letter CORE lockup cannot be reproduced glyph-for-glyph for a 14-letter name, and the stacked layout is a fitting choice rather than a source trace.
